x_query.oql:
works where date <= (2026-08-31)
  and title/abstract has (
    (
      LiDAR
      or stemmed "laser scanning"
      or stemmed "point cloud"
      or mapping
      or survey
    )
    and (
      stemmed "backpack scanner"
      or stemmed "handheld scanner"
      or stemmed "legged robot"
      or stemmed "mobile mapping"
      or stemmed "wheeled-legged"
      or quadruped
      or robot
      or robotic
    )
    and (
      stemmed "bulk material"
      or stemmed "coal pile"
      or stemmed "ore pile"
      or stockpile
    )
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=to_publication_date:2026-08-31,title_and_abstract.search:LiDAR|%22laser scanning%22|%22point cloud%22|mapping|survey,title_and_abstract.search:%22backpack scanner%22|%22handheld scanner%22|%22legged robot%22|%22mobile mapping%22|%22wheeled-legged%22|quadruped|robot|robotic,title_and_abstract.search:%22bulk material%22|%22coal pile%22|%22ore pile%22|stockpile&per_page=200&cursor=%2A
